title: Cardiograph-7: continuous ambulatory ECG ready for 510(k)
audience: medical device board reviewing pre-submission package
core_points: Device class: ambulatory ECG patch with on-device AF detection, FDA Class II
Pre-submission meeting held Q4 2025; feedback: expand real-world perf sampling before 510(k)
Clinical bridge study: 1,847 patients, 87 sites, 14-day continuous monitoring
Sensitivity for AF ≥30 sec: 96.8% (vs predicate 94.1%); specificity 99.2%
Adverse events: 12 skin reactions, 0 serious device-related events
Usability testing summary: 58 of 60 participants completed attach-without-assist task
Manufacturing: 2 QMS suppliers qualified, capacity 40K units/mo by approval
Cybersecurity: post-market monitoring plan meets FDA 2023 guidance, PSIRT stood up
Labeling deltas vs predicate: 14-day wear, AF classification added to IFU
Reimbursement pathway: existing 93225 CPT code covers claimed indications
Pre-submission corrective actions: addressed all 7 items from FDA Q4 feedback
Ask: board approval to submit 510(k) by end of Q2
